rules: Freeze source-backed held-out fixtures and labels before provider calls.
Use calibration cases for prompt, schema, reasoning, and adapter selection only.
Give every compared model the same declared calibration-arm budget.
After configuration freeze, use held-out confirmation once for model-selection claims.

Set model_selection_status to eligible_held_out_confirmation only after the held-out partition and all compared configurations are frozen; held-out presence alone never makes a selection claim eligible.
A valid regression failure may block a runtime/default change even when held-out selection evidence passes.
A regression-only pass or failure is capability evidence, not an unbiased winner claim.

held_out_creation.inventory_result: Existing Onward output history contains only three logical crop keys outside the maintained 40-case corpus. All three are visually pass-style; page-012-002 and page-122-002 reuse source pages already exposed in calibration. They cannot provide a balanced, source-page-independent safety confirmation slice.

minimum_confirmation_contract.label_review: Inspect source page and crop together, record the source-backed reason and hashes, then obtain an independent second review before freezing.

held_out_creation.expansion_rule: If a predeclared 12-case candidate slice has fewer than six natural production failures, add four previously unused source pages at a time and review every crop from those pages. Do not synthesize defects, cherry-pick by validator output, or call providers before the slice is frozen.

crop-validation.selection_exposure: The caption-focus prompt was selected from six variants on this full 40-case corpus, and the incumbent plus challengers were repeatedly ranked on the same cases.

crop-page-level-deletion-gate.selection_exposure: The prompt was repaired on observed incumbent failures and the provider default was selected after repeated full-corpus comparisons.
